sources.entry: Cloudreve - File management and sharing system, supports multiple storage providers. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go
Cloudreve | Cloud storage system supporting multiple storage providers

summary.one_liner: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system that stores files across multiple cloud storage providers, with a web interface, WebDAV, and online previews.
summary.what_it_does: Cloudreve stores files in local disk, remote nodes, OneDrive, S3-compatible APIs, Qiniu Kodo, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, Huawei Cloud OBS, Kingsoft Cloud KS3, and Upyun. Clients upload and download directly to the storage provider. It can hand downloads off to Aria2 or qBittorrent, optionally across multiple download nodes. Users can compress, extract, and preview archives, and batch-download files. It offers WebDAV access across all storage providers, drag-and-drop uploads with parallel resumable transfers, and metadata extraction with search by metadata or tags. Multi-user and multi-group management, share links with expiration dates, and online preview or editing of videos, images, documents, Markdown, and Office files are also included.
use_cases: share files and folders via expiring links
manage files across multiple cloud storage providers
online preview and editing of documents and media
offline downloads via Aria2 or qBittorrent
how_to_run: See the Getting started and Deploy documents referenced in the README for local testing and production deployment
See the Build document in the README to build from source
notable: Uploads and downloads go directly between client and storage provider
Supports many cloud storage backends including Chinese providers like Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, and Upyun
WebDAV support across all storage providers
Integrates with Aria2 and qBittorrent with multiple download nodes
All-in-one packaging with features out of the box
caveats: README does not state platform limits or hardware requirements
Deployment details are in external documentation, not the README itself
